extensionDescription.message: Assistive extension for people with color vision deficiency

maxPixelsHint.message: Max number of pixels to process. A higher number means it takes longer to process the selection.

permissionError.message: You need to grant the extension permission to "access your data for all websites".

permissionFirefox.message: Go to about:addons, click on "color helper", click on "Permissions" and grant the permission.

reduceUnmatchedOpacity.message: Reduce opacity for unmatched color shades

pauseOnClickHint.message: Useful when you want to copy the color

colorThemeAdapt.message: Attempt to adapt to the current website's design

showMatchQuality.message: Show Matched Color Quality and Distance (ΔE)

showAlternativeShade.message: Show heuristic color shade below the main color shade

useCompatModeHint.message: When you experience blank analyze views although the hover is still working, turn this option on.

addContextMenu.message: Add Analyze Options to Context Menu

maxPixelsDesc.message: When the product of your selection's dimensions exceeds the configured value, the selection will be internally scaled down.

resetDesc.message: Resetting the extension will restore the default settings. This action cannot be undone.

aboutDesc.message: This extension is intended to help colorblind people to better understand the colors they see on the web and to make online content more accessible to them.

aboutGithub.message: Project page and sourcecode on GitHub

aboutIsitred.message: isit.red - my assistive app for color vision deficient people

aboutBlog.message: More on colorblindness on my blog

aboutBug.message: Found a bug? Post it here!

aboutDisclaimer.message: This extension is a hobby project and is provided as is. I am not responsible for any damage or loss of data caused by the use of this extension.

aboutPrivacy.message: This extension respects your privacy. It does not collect any personal data. It does not track you.

settingsHint.message: If you disable the "Settings" button, you can still access the settings by right-clicking the extension icon and selecting "Options".
